أَرْضٌ تَيْمَآءُ A [desert] land such as is termed قَفْرَة, that causes one to lose his way and to perish: or a wide tract of land: (M, K:) or a land in which is no water: (T:) and تَيْمَآءُ alone a [desert such as is termed] فَلَاة; (T, S, K;) because one loses his way therein: (T:) and a wide فَلَاة. (T.) ＝
-A2- التَّيْمَآءُ The stars of الجَوْزَآء [app. meaning Gemini, also called التَّوْءَمَانِ]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
